# Laprrk Technology Solutions

> Laprrk Technology Solutions LLP builds production software and AI systems, places screened engineers, and trains teams, from Greater Noida West, India and Louisville, Kentucky, USA.

## Overview

Three practices under one partner: IT services (17 services across software, AI, cloud, data, DevOps, QA, security and enterprise apps), hiring consultation (permanent, contract, RPO, executive search, GCC setup, campus hire-train-deploy), and corporate training for IT corporates and institutes (around 70% hands-on lab time).

Founded 2019. Offices: Greater Noida West (Uttar Pradesh, India) and Louisville (Kentucky, USA). Contact: info@laprrk.com, +91 88606 64929, +1 (502) 309-5749.
